static void dlg_close_light(void)
{
    /* one fast bulk fill => dialog vanishes instantly; the following
       waveform repaint sweeps over an already-dark background */
    lcd_fill_rectangle(DLG_X0, DLG_Y0, DLG_X1, DLG_Y1, BLACK);
    /* Dialog lies fully inside the wave area; the next waveform update
       repaints it completely in a single pass - nothing else to erase. */
}
